content: The abovementioned rules are intended to support the current design of the OMB+ learning platform. However, additional MERs could be added to generate new transitions. Exemplifying this, we conducted experiments with the former design of the platform, where all the topics, except for the first one, had only sub-topics, whereas the first topic had both sub-topics and sub-sub-topics. We could effortlessly generate the missing transitions with our approach. The number of possible transitions, in this case, increased from 56 to 117.
